knowledge_religion.name: Knowledge (Religion)
knowledge_religion.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (religion) gives +2 on turning checks against undead. Identifies Undead.

actions.name: Identify Undead Monster
actions.description: Recall vulnerabilities to positive energy, holy water, silver/bludgeoning bypasses, and spawn rules (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Recall Divine Pantheons, Holy Symbols, and Liturgy
actions.description: Recognize patron deities, consecrated altars, holy relics, taboos, and ancient ecclesiastical heresies.
